# Empowr Heroes

> Empowr Heroes is the fundraising and donation platform for Empowr CIC, enabling individuals and organisations to support community programmes through direct giving.

Empowr Heroes provides a transparent, mission-aligned giving experience — connecting donors to the real impact of Empowr CIC's work in education, employment, and community empowerment. Every donation directly funds programmes that create opportunity for people in underserved communities.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://heroes.empowrcic.org): Overview of Empowr Heroes and featured campaigns
- [Donate](https://heroes.empowrcic.org/donate): Make a donation to support Empowr CIC's programmes
- [Impact](https://heroes.empowrcic.org/impact): How donations are used and the difference they make

## About

Empowr Heroes is operated by Empowr CIC (empowrcic.org), a UK-based Community Interest Company. All funds raised through Empowr Heroes support Empowr CIC's community programmes.

## Contact
